summary: Iteration 12 RETEST (frontend-only, mobile viewport 390x844, delivered+t1@resend.dev / Testpass123, Free plan). CRITICAL fix from iter 11 VERIFIED: shift-clear-button is now rendered on the MAIN shift form via `<StackHeader title={title} right={...}>` in /app/frontend/app/shift-form.tsx lines 162-169. All three clear/undo flows pass. (1) Add shift (via shifts-add-fab): filled location='Clear Test', duty=overtime, period=night (times → 20:00/08:00), tapped shift-clear-button → location reset to '', duty back to Standard, period Day, times 08:00/20:00. ✓ (2) Duplicate shift (via shift-action-duplicate on an existing RetestLocA shift): location pre-filled with 'RetestLocA' and clear-btn label='Clear'; tapped shift-clear-button → location='' and title/text becomes 'Add shift'. ✓ (3) Edit shift (via shift-action-edit): clear-btn label='Undo changes' ✓; changed location to 'CHANGED_X' then tapped shift-clear-button → location reverted to 'RetestLocA' (original saved value) ✓; back out — nothing was saved. The nonce-based remount (ShiftFormScreen key `${id}|${duplicate}|${date}|${n}`) continues to work for fresh form after edit/duplicate. REGRESSION: creating and deleting shifts still works; cleanup removed all test shifts (0 cards remaining). STILL FAILING (carryover from iter 11 — not retested as in-scope but re-confirmed): on Shifts and Earnings tabs the 'Up to date' toast does NOT appear after tapping header-refresh-button, even with 6s polling, while on Home the toast fires at poll ~2 (~300ms). The sync badge still transitions to 'Synced' on both Shifts and Earnings, so syncNow() runs; however the toast never renders via the testID='toast-message' selector. The HeaderActions code is identical across tabs (same component imported from /app/frontend/src/components/sync-badge.tsx line 49), so the divergence suggests either (a) a stale ToastProvider instance per tab stack (ToastProvider mounted inside each tab layout rather than once at root), or (b) syncNow()/refreshUser() rejecting silently on the Shifts/Earnings tabs (HeaderActions.catch would then show 'Couldn't refresh', which was NOT seen either — I polled the toast-message testID for all text, not just 'Up to date'). No React Native red screens. Console noise unchanged (shadow* deprecation, two 403 on anonymous assets at boot).

integration_issues.issue: Toast 'Up to date' only renders on Home. On Shifts and Earnings tabs the toast-message element never appears after tapping header-refresh-button (polled 6s / 40×150ms). Sync badge still cycles to 'Synced', so syncNow() succeeds. Error toast 'Couldn't refresh' is also not shown. Suspected root cause: ToastProvider may be mounted inside each tab layout rather than at the app root — in /app/frontend/src/components/sync-badge.tsx HeaderActions calls useToast(); if the provider wrapping the Shifts/Earnings screens is a different instance than the one whose Animated.View is actually rendered on screen, show() mutates the wrong state. Quick check: `grep -rn 'ToastProvider' /app/frontend/app /app/frontend/src` to confirm there is exactly one ToastProvider wrapping the whole app (and that HeaderActions reads from the SAME context on every tab). Alternative: syncNow() on these tabs may be returning a rejected promise that the catch swallows without toasting — add a console.log in sync-badge.tsx:55-65 to confirm which branch runs.
